name: Calendar
author: Andreia
description: Mini calendar agenda for your schedule — day, week, and month views; one-time and repeating events; per-event reminders; and two-way sync with Obsidian daily notes: events are written into the daily note in the folder Obsidian uses (the "New file location"), and can be imported back from reading those notes.
